name: createSession
shortDescription: Creates a new session for a Molecule, initiated by a Lead Point, including start and end times.
description:
Overview

Creates a new Session record associated with a specific Molecule, setting its initial status and time parameters.

Intended use

Called by the Lead Point persona from the Session Control Panel UI to initiate a new work session for a Molecule. Parameters include moleculeId, name, startTime, and endTime.

Logic

  1. Validate that params.moleculeId exists by querying the Molecule entity using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  2. Create a new Session record using ctx.data.create with moleculeId, name, startTime, endTime, and idOfUser (from ctx.user_id).
  3. Audit-log the session creation using ctx.audit.log, including the new session's ID.
  4. Return the created Session record.

Entities

  • Session
  • Molecule
